title: Source catalogue, adapter generations and source multiplicity
summary: CivicSourceCatalog negotiates exact caller-accepted generations without semver guessing. Built-in adapters preserve singular versus collection source shape and pin endpoint/query/credential policy/Runtime contract metadata without performing I/O.
invariants: latest, wildcard, empty and duplicate generation tokens fail closed.
Caller ordering is preference order; the catalogue does not infer newest or semver precedence.
Adapter implementation selection is closed/explicit, not reflection-based.
Postcode uses postcodes.io.postcode/0.2; Companies House uses companieshouse.company-profile/0.1; AWC METAR uses aviationweather.metar/0.1.
METAR remains zero-to-many; no element-zero/latest guess is permitted.
Structured source members such as METAR clouds and company SIC arrays remain in native evidence unless an explicit projection is designed.
procedure: Add a source descriptor only after endpoint/query and mapping generation are pinned.
Expose mapAll(document) so generic callers can preserve multiplicity.
Cross-check descriptor mapping/ability/contract pins against Runtime Registry in integration tests.

provenance.claim: Exact-generation source catalogue, closed adapter selection, fixed non-secret metadata and Runtime cross-check.
METAR collection validity and preservation of structured/union source members.
